subject: Math
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, $x$ and $y$, for data set A. A line of best fit for the data is also shown. Data set B is created by subtracting $13$ units from the value of $y$ for each data point from data set A. Which of the following is closest to the $y$-coordinate of the $y$-intercept of the line of best fit for data set B?
explanation: Choice B is correct. When a constant value is subtracted from all $y$-coordinates in a dataset, the line of best fit shifts vertically downward by that same constant amount. The scatterplot shows that the line of best fit for data set A has a $y$-intercept of approximately $47.25$. Since data set B is created by subtracting $13$ units from the $y$-value of each point in data set A, the $y$-intercept of the line of best fit for data set B will be $47.25 - 13 = 34.25$. Therefore, the $y$-coordinate of the $y$-intercept of the line of best fit for data set B is closest to $34.25$.
